I was looking at telescope optics a long while ago with the intent of building a telescope. What I learned from browsing is that beyond some point the extra magnification is useless because it does not reveal extra detail. So do not be overzealous at the magnification department. Telescope building forums are an excellent source for this kind of information. There are also YT videos.

Moon and stars require different eyepieces. A set of two or three should cover all bases but is not sensible to buy right away, especially if interest is lost and the telescope is put in the attic after the novelty wears off.

Ebay is a source for eyepieces. Not necessarily a good one but it is a source.
